assertions.description: Client meeting prep workflow state.yaml shows status: complete

Stage 5 Phase 4A: step-06 spawns Ralph (client-meeting-prep-verification workflow) and records an 'adversarial-verification' guardrail result on this run. Read from the eval record's own guardrails array. This is the distinct-lens check Tim's Stage 5 finding requires: a separate agent tracing every attendee/company fact in the prep sheet back to calendar, email, or CRM source data.

Chase H1 (prep-sheet completeness — account context): the prep sheet carries the mandatory 'Who They Are' company-context section. Checked against the most recently written .md in meetings/ (this workflow's own save convention has no skill/date prefix to glob-scope by).

Chase H1 (prep-sheet completeness — attendee research): the prep sheet carries the mandatory attendee-bio section ('Who He/She/They Is'), which is where step-03's attendee research lands. Attendee research present is a required part of H1.

Chase H1 (prep-sheet completeness — talking points): the prep sheet carries the mandatory calibrated 'Suggested Talking Points' section. Completeness = attendee research + account context + talking points, all three required by step-04's document structure.

Chase H2 (reason-for-call verification): the prep sheet carries the mandatory 'Reason for the Call' section, which step-04 requires be grounded in step-02's email-derived reason_for_call. Pass = 100% of client preps.

Chase H2 (reason-for-call verification): the prep sheet cites its email evidence — a thread/subject/introduction reference, or an explicit statement that none was found. Proxy for step-04's rule that Reason for the Call must cite a specific email thread (sender, subject, date) or state plainly that none was found. Honest limit: this is a presence check on citation markers, not a semantic verification that the cited thread is the right one; the semantic layer is covered by the adversarial-verification checkpoint (cmp-002).

Chase H3 (data-grounding, no fabricated pipeline): the prep sheet references at least one live source (CRM/Dynamics, Clay, LinkedIn, PowerBI, the email thread, the calendar). Honest limit: this is a grounding-marker presence check — it confirms the sheet names a source, not that every figure traces to it. The per-fact traceability layer is the adversarial-verification checkpoint (cmp-002), where Ralph traces every attendee/company fact back to calendar/email/CRM.
